plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-11 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Geology (BS) program page and its linked official degree map, 'Geology Degree Maps (2026-2027)', Geology (Campus) tab, last updated/reviewed July 27, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. The catalog prints Total Credits, BS Degree: 120 (BS only; no BA version), which the map matches exactly. Every term's courses sum to the map's printed term total (16/16/14/15/13/12/6 summer/15/13) and the plan to 120. The map's nine terms include a Summer (3rd Year) term carrying GEO 4960 Field Geology (6 credits), which the catalog lists inside its Core Requirements (36 credits) with no term specified; the term is transcribed as printed in the map. Cross-check: the catalog's Geology Curriculum totals 82 credits (Introductory Requirement 4, Core Requirements 36, Required Support Courses 32, Geology Electives minimum 10), and every named curriculum course appears in the map. Catalog-versus-map differences are transcribed as printed in the map and disclosed here, not reconciled: (1) GEO 4000 Selected Field Trips is listed in the catalog once as 0.5-3 credits with 2 credits required; the map splits it as 1 credit in Year 2 Spring and 1 credit in Year 3 Spring (total 2) — allow_repeated_courses is set for this printed repeat. (2) The map's Year 1 Fall introductory row is generic ('Geology Introductory Course & Lab* (GE Physical)', 4 credits, no course code), while the catalog requires one of seven named lecture/lab pairings (GEO 1010 & GEO 1115; GEO 1030 & GEO 1115; GEO 1040 & GEO 1115; GEO 1050 & GEO 1055; GEO 1090 & GEO 1095; GEO 1110 & GEO 1115; GEO 2210 & GEO 2215); it is recorded as a choice slot. (3) The map schedules 11 credits of generic GEO/GEOG geology elective rows (4+4 in Year 4 Fall, 3 in Year 4 Spring), while the catalog requires a minimum of 10 credits from its named elective list; the map therefore exceeds the catalog minimum by 1 credit, and the plan total is still 120. Titles follow the map (which abbreviates with ampersands where the catalog spells 'and' out). GE and elective rows printed without course codes are recorded as choice slots with synthetic codes.
